title: Deglado
statement: A 2n×2n grid has every column a permutation of 1..2n (n ≤ 80). One operation swaps the top and bottom halves of a 2×2 subgrid, applying one adjacent row swap to two neighbouring columns. The task is to sort all columns within n·C(2n,2)+9n operations or print -1. Each operation flips two column parities, so the answer is -1 exactly when an odd number of columns are odd permutations.
